info.name: API
info.description:
# Library Management System API

REST API for a Library Management System — Books, Authors, Publishers, Categories,  
Members, System Users, and Borrowing/Return — with JWT authentication and  
role-based access control (Administrator, Librarian, Staff).

## Before you start

1. Run **Auth → Login** first. On success, a script auto-saves the returned  
    token into the `token` collection variable — every other request in this  
    collection inherits Bearer auth from it automatically. No manual copying.
    
2. Default seeded login:Email: [admin@library.com](https://mailto:admin@library.com)  
    Password: Admin@12345
    
3. Confirm `baseUrl` (collection Variables tab) matches wherever the API is  
    actually running.
    

## A few things worth trying

- \- \`GET /api/books?searchTerm=&categoryId=&status=\` — filter/search Books by  
    name, author, category, or status, all through one endpoint.
    
- \- Log in as Librarian or Staff (create one via \`POST /api/systemusers\` as  
    Administrator first) to see role-based access control in action — some  
    endpoints will correctly return 403 depending on the role.
    
- \- \`POST /api/borrowing/borrow\` then \`POST /api/borrowing/{transactionId}/return\`  
    — watch the linked book's \`Status\` field flip between requests.
    
- \- \`GET /api/activitylogs\` — every create/update/delete across the API is  
    logged automatically; this endpoint surfaces that audit trail.EndFragment
